title: The Collapse of The American Dream Explained in Animation
summary: A 30-minute animated film explaining how money, banking and the Federal Reserve work and arguing that the American economy is heading for collapse. It is opinionated and has a strong point of view.
why: Recommended as an accessible animated primer on banking and the Fed, usually with the caveat that it is biased and dated.

quote.text: There's this amazing animated movie from 2011 that explains how banking works and the history of banks
